description:
Base on-chain read: a block by number or 'latest'. Latest Base block via eth_getBlockByNumber (pass block=latest): returns the block number, timestamp, hash and gas used as the node reports them. One paid call, no key.

GET https://api.arysphere.com/v1/ventures/x402_chain_reads_v1/base_latest_block_time. Same payment terms as that HTTP route.
Call once with no payment. The result is the payment terms. Retry the same call with the signed payment at _meta["x402/payment"].
name: x402_chain_reads_v1__base_latest_block_time
